sources.title: Immigration and General Services
sources.publisher: Ministry of Revenue and Customs, Government of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The live revenue.gov.to Immigration and General Services page is published by Tonga’s Ministry of Revenue and Customs; normal certificate validation failed, so the page was reopened with a certificate-validation bypass.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Travellers who are citizens of the following countries may be issued a 30 day visitor visa on arrival.

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga in the People’s Republic of China
sources.officialityEvidence: The live tongaembassycn.gov.to consular page is published by Tonga’s embassy in China and provides named visitor-entry lists.
sources.supportingExcerpt: They will be issued upon arrival with a visitor’s visa for 31 days.

sources.title: Going to Tonga
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Kingdom of Tonga in the People’s Republic of China
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy of Tonga in China page describes the stamped advance letter-of-authority path for an unlisted traveller.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a letter of authority allowing them to travel to Tonga

sources.title: Agreement between the European Union and Tonga on the short-stay visa waiver
sources.officialityEvidence: EUR-Lex republishes the treaty as an in-force Official Journal instrument; its joint declaration calls for separate Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein agreements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: conclude, without delay, bilateral agreements on the short-stay visa waiver

sources.title: Immigration Act, Chapter 10.01 (2020 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: Tonga’s Attorney General’s Office publishes the revised Immigration Act; it sets permit and visa powers but no current nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visitor permit may be issued at the discretion of an immigration officer.

sources.title: Immigration (Amendment) Act 2025
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General’s Office publishes Act 28 of 2025; it changes definitions in section 2 and supplies no visitor-nationality schedule or timing reconciliation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Section 2 of the Principal Act is amended by inserting new definitions.

sources.title: Immigration Regulations, Chapter 10.01.01 (2020 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: Tonga’s Attorney General’s Office publishes the revised Immigration Regulations, including visitor-permit forms and fees.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitor’s Permit for non-citizens who require permits for entry.

sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General’s Office current treaty collection identifies the published New Zealand–Tonga visa-waiver entry but supplies no reconciliation for the disputed codes.

sources.title: Gazettes by Year: 2026
sources.publisher: Attorney General’s Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Attorney General’s Office 2026 Gazette index and all four listed gazettes were reopened; none publishes an immigration nationality-schedule reconciliation.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Norway
sources.officialityEvidence: Norway’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs current Tonga travel advice was updated 3 August 2026 and expressly describes Norwegian-citizen arrival visa issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Norske borgere får visum ved ankomst for opphold inntil 90 dager.

policies.title: Norwegian ordinary passports: visitor visa issued on arrival
policies.summary: Tonga Revenue’s current schedule names Norway for a visitor visa on arrival, and Norway’s current Foreign Ministry advice independently states that Norwegian citizens receive a visa on arrival. This is normalized as visa_on_arrival; the sources’ stated durations are not combined.
conditions: Revenue qualifies arrival issuance with a valid return ticket, sufficient funds, and immigration decision; the Norwegian advice states a stay up to 90 days, while Revenue describes 30 days.
This is an ordinary-passport short-visitor mapping only; it establishes no work, residence, transit, special-document, biometric, or individual-admission entitlement.
The older Embassy page’s Schengen visa-free wording conflicts with the two current government guidance sources and is not used to normalize this code as visa_free.

conflicts.explanation: Tonga Revenue and Norway’s current Foreign Ministry advice both describe a visitor visa issued at arrival for Norwegian citizens. The current fallback classifies NO:TO as visa_free.

unresolved.reason: Revenue’s residual says this passport needs a visa before arrival, while the Embassy’s named list says a 31-day visitor visa is issued on arrival. The Act, Regulations, treaty collection, and published 2026 gazettes do not reconcile the conflict.
